whatsappMessage:
Hi Team 10 Hour's Family Restaurant,

I noticed your family restaurant has strong 4.7★ reviews in the Jakkanpur-Gardanibagh area of Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table reservations and home delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur popular dishes ki gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/10hours

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team 10 Hour's Family Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (10 Hour's Family Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservations, and a mobile-first showcase of your top dishes in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
